fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our expected fuel consumption in 2010, a one dollar increase in the price of crude oil will increase our annual fuel expense by approximately $41 million (implies ~1,722 million projected gallons for 2010).

instrument_type_details.notes: At Dec 31, 2009: Gulf Coast jet fuel swaps 1% of 2010 consumption (at $1.94/gal); WTI crude oil swaps 2% (at $1.84/gal); WTI crude oil call options 4% (at $2.20/gal). Total maximum price hedge: 7%, minimum price hedge: 3%. Fair value $14 million asset. Significant reduction from 23% hedged at year-end 2008 due to high cost of hedging post-2008 crash.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed (millions) 1,395 [2009] 1,498 [2008] 1,542 [2007] (Item 6 selected operating data; Continental Airlines standalone)
